links.outcome: Outdated or incorrect clinical knowledge in GPT-4 answers to vascular surgery scenarios
links.effect: GPT-4 quoted incorrect or outdated information in 14% of failed cases and could not comprehend context, nuances, and medical classification systems in 11%; over 65% of 385 questions answered correctly.
links.quote: The AI model also quoted incorrect or outdated information in 14% of cases and showed an inability to comprehend context, nuances, and medical classification systems in 11% of the cases.

screen.reason: Evaluates the standalone accuracy of GPT-4 across 57 textbook-derived vascular surgery scenarios without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
